question: Does a lower atmospheric vapor-pressure deficit on the wetter survey predict emergence of new full choruses beyond the existing DaysSinceRain contrast?

source.dataset: Daymet Daily North America Version 4 / R1 via Planetary Computer collection daymet-daily-na

run_level_weather.site_linkage: Use the pinned physical SiteID coordinates for the ten non-skipped NAAMP stops in each eligible run.
run_level_weather.completeness: Require >=8 of 10 SiteIDs with finite Daymet values for each run.
run_level_weather.run_vpd: Mean VPD across valid SiteIDs on the survey date.
run_level_weather.run_vp: Mean Daymet vp across valid SiteIDs on the survey date.
run_level_weather.run_prcp3: Mean across valid SiteIDs of cumulative Daymet prcp over survey date and previous two calendar days.

pair_predictors.delta_vpd: wet run minus dry run; negative means wetter member had lower atmospheric drying demand.
pair_predictors.delta_vp: wet minus dry; positive means wetter member had higher vapor pressure.

response.primary: new_ci3_count = number of species x stop cells with dry CallingIndex=0 and wet CallingIndex=3.
response.secondary: strong_new_score = sum wet CallingIndex over cells with dry=0 and wet in {2,3}.

primary_model: new_ci3_count ~ rain_contrast + delta_vpd + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + State + RunNumber, route-clustered covariance.
sensitivities: Replace delta_vpd with delta_vp; expected coefficient >0.
Replace delta_vpd with delta_prcp3; expected coefficient >0.
Repeat the primary model in the existing same-observer + physical-stop pair subset.
Report percent change in the rain_contrast coefficient relative to the same complete-case model without delta_vpd as descriptive attenuation only; no mediation threshold.
minimum_gate: At least 3000 matched pairs, >=450 routes, >=18 states with complete Daymet weather in both runs.
interpretation: Support would make atmospheric hydration stress a plausible proximal cue in addition to rainfall recency.
Daily VPD is not survey-time microclimate and cannot establish physiological mediation.
Failure would not rule out humidity at the exact survey hour, soil/wetland hydrology, or other rainfall-associated cues.
No causal rainfall or reproductive-success claim, and no RC11 submission change is authorized.
